_source: hpc.iiserb.ac.in cluster pages and 'Policies & Usage Charges', as supplied by the user on 2026-10-23.
_notes: Raman cores per node: the site lists 'Xeon Gold 6126, 12 cores' (a 12-core CPU); 24 per node assumes 2 sockets, consistent with pilot data ('2 x 12-cores Intel Xeon Gold 6126, 96 GB RAM'). TO CONFIRM.
Raman GPU node: model not listed; recalled as a Volta-generation card. Not needed by the form for now.

Storage split: each cluster's usable storage is divided into home and scratch by storage.scratchFraction (committee parameter; usually home:scratch 60:40, set to 50:50 for now). homeTB and scratchTB are computed from it in clusterConfig.ts.

Scheduler limits apply to a whole research group (at most two users: the faculty member and one group member), not to each user. queues[].maxConcurrentJobs = jobs one group may have running at once in that queue. groupLimits (per cluster, across all its queues): maxRunningJobs = jobs a group may have running at once in all queues together; maxRunningNodes = nodes a group's running jobs may occupy in total; maxQueuedJobs = jobs a group may have waiting; fairShare = whether a fair-share policy balances groups' usage (at present: Raman yes, Gargi no). null = none or not yet confirmed (hardware check).

storage.scratchOnlyOnFastPFS: true when only scratch is on the fast parallel file system (home elsewhere). Jobs should then load their input files from scratch, so the analysis counts read volume (W_input_read) toward scratch as well as written volume. null = to confirm with the convener.

committeeParameters._comment: Set by the HPC Users' Committee; used by the form's follow-up triggers. The evaluation parameters used only at the analysis stage (availability, usable share of available time, scratch and home guides, charges, allowance, candidate queues) are in analysis/parameters.json and set through the form in notebook 07.

thresholds._comment: Values that follow-up triggers compare workload answers against (via configRef). Derived from the clusters above; edit here, not in the schema. null disables the trigger.
thresholds._derivedComment: scratchPerJobTriggerGB and scratchConcurrentTriggerGB are computed in clusterConfig.ts as committeeParameters fractions of the smallest cluster scratch area.
